clue.text: Army helicopter threatening warmonger

a hawk is a politician who favours war

explanation.surface: A military aircraft described as menacing and bellicose.
explanation.definitionFit: The Black Hawk is the US Army's standard utility helicopter, built by Sikorsky.

clue.text: Johnson's one sending soldiers in again

indicators.note: the soldiers are sent in, placed inside the word for again

parts.note: bis is the call for a repeat, meaning twice or again
OR, other ranks, is the usual abbreviation for ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A prime minister Johnson redeploying troops to a war zone a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: BIS is Latin-derived musical shorthand for 'again' or 'repeat'.
explanation.definitionFit: Boris is the first name of the British prime minister Johnson, so it is the one among Johnsons meant.

clue.text: Hallucinogen produced from stale dung

indicators.note: the answer is made out of the rearranged letters of the two following words

explanation.surface: A drug supposedly extracted from old manure.
explanation.definitionFit: Angel dust is the street name for the drug PCP, which causes hallucinations.

clue.text: She parks by building way across mountains

indicators.note: building means constructing something anew from these letters

explanation.surface: A woman leaves her car beside a construction site.
explanation.definitionFit: The Khyber Pass is the famous route through the mountains between Afghanistan and Pakistan.

clue.text: Performer such as Tatum is brought to vacant theatre

parts.note: Art Tatum was a celebrated American jazz pianist, an example of someone called Art

indicators.note: vacant means emptied of its middle, leaving only the outside letters of theatre

explanation.surface: A jazz pianist booked to play in an empty playhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: An artiste is a professional entertainer, such as a singer or dancer.

clue.text: Territory no good party covered in imperialistic work

indicators.note: the pieces are wrapped inside the title of the novel

a do is a party or celebration

explanation.definitionFit: A kingdom is a realm or area ruled by a monarch.

clue.text: Old bread companion leaves in theatre

explanation.definitionFit: Theatre and drama are both names for plays as an art form.

clue.text: Male takes female round London landmark

indicators.note: the female's letters go round the letter for the male

parts.note: a doe is a female deer or rabbit

explanation.surface: A man takes his partner on a tour of a famous London sight.
explanation.definitionFit: The Millennium Dome on the Greenwich peninsula, now the O2 arena, is a London landmark.

clue.text: Saint taking long time to grasp point

indicators.note: the long time holds the point inside it

parts.note: ages is an informal long time
N, north, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A holy figure needing ages to understand something.
explanation.definitionFit: St Agnes of Rome is a virgin martyr venerated as a saint.

clue.text: Not taking drink out — can found inside

indicators.note: the can is located within the word for out

parts.note: absent means out, not present
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: A teetotaller notices an empty can somewhere inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone abstinent refrains from alcohol, a teetotaller.

clue.text: School sport?

definitions.meaning: ... School is an English public school in Warwickshire
the game played with an oval ball, invented at that school

explanation.surface: A short question about games played at school.
explanation.definitionFit: Rugby is both the Warwickshire public school and the ball game said to have begun there.

clue.text: Eastern people in canvas shelters and flats

indicators.note: the people sit inside the canvas shelters

men are people

clue.text: Metal right for example in joint

clue.text: Sebastiano in town? On the contrary!

explanation.surface: Asks whether a man called Sebastiano is in town, then reverses itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a town in Piedmont, Italy, famous for its sparkling wine.

clue.text: Plucked from thousands of orthodontists et cetera

indicators.note: the answer is pulled out of the run of letters in the following words, like a tooth

explanation.surface: Teeth extracted by many dentists, and so on.
explanation.definitionFit: Et cetera is Latin for 'and the rest', the same as the English phrase.

clue.text: Bottom in semicircle to collapse

indicators.note: the bottom is placed inside the half circle

parts.note: half of the word circle, its last three letters
rump is the bottom or backside

explanation.surface: Someone sits down in a half circle and falls over.
explanation.definitionFit: To crumple is to fold up or fall down in a heap, to collapse.

clue.text: Whip coats politician in creamy cheese

indicators.note: the whip wraps around the politician

parts.note: the cat o' nine tails is a whip, cat for short
a member of parliament is a politician

explanation.definitionFit: Camembert is a soft, creamy cheese from Normandy.

clue.text: Married Frenchman's one European lacking excitement

parts.note: un is French for one
a Dane is a European from Denmark

explanation.surface: A wedded Frenchman finds a single European dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Mundane means ordinary and dull, without excitement.

clue.text: Bikini perhaps concealed by nurse as religious leader appears

indicators.note: the Pacific island is hidden inside the nurse

parts.note: an ayah is a nursemaid in South Asia
Bikini is an atoll in the Marshall Islands

explanation.surface: A cleric arrives while a nurse hides a swimsuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bikini' wants to be the swimsuit; it is the Pacific atoll.
explanation.definitionFit: An ayatollah is a senior Shiite cleric, as in Iran.

clue.text: German with old relative shortly creates division

parts.note: mit is German for with
sis is the short form of sister, a relative

explanation.surface: A German and his elderly relative cause a split.
explanation.definitionFit: Mitosis is cell division in which one nucleus splits into two identical ones.

clue.text: Son, mischievous, inconsiderate toward others

parts.note: elfish means impish, mischievous like an elf

explanation.surface: A naughty boy who ignores other people.
explanation.definitionFit: Selfish people care about themselves and disregard the needs of others.

clue.text: Coffee time?

definitions.meaning: powdered coffee made by adding hot water
a moment, a very short time

explanation.surface: Asks whether it is time for a coffee break.
explanation.definitionFit: Instant is both soluble coffee and a single moment of time.

clue.text: Exclamation of annoyance as interrogator clarifies roles?

definitions.meaning: a cry of exasperation at someone's behaviour
a questioner explaining who does what: me questioning, you answering

explanation.surface: An exasperated questioner spelling out who asks and who answers.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an exasperated cry, and also literally what a questioner says about the two roles.

clue.text: Look down on people initially invading Middle East

takes the first letter of each of the two words before it

explanation.definitionFit: To mope is to appear dejected and gloomy, to look downcast.

clue.text: Attractive Romeo ditched as small-minded

clue.text: Result of downpour, one light, then another

parts.note: a flash is a light, as on a camera
another light, a floodlight, known as a flood

explanation.surface: A storm with lightning flash after flash.
explanation.definitionFit: A flash flood is a sudden local flood caused by very heavy rain.

clue.text: Wheat anyone can see in part of kitchen

indicators.note: the film rating goes inside the instrument

parts.note: the kitchen is slang for an orchestra's percussion section, of which a drum is part
U is the British film certificate meaning suitable for all

explanation.surface: A grain anyone can see in a corner of the kitchen.

clue.text: Pit in Devonshire drained by conservationists

indicators.note: drained of contents, leaving only the outer letters of the county

parts.note: NT, the National Trust, is a British conservation charity

explanation.definitionFit: A dent is a small hollow or depression, a pit in a surface.

clue.text: Governor in something made to measure

definitions.meaning: a straight-edged strip for measuring lengths

explanation.surface: A governor in a made-to-measure suit.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruler is both one who rules and a measuring stick.

clue.text: Rely on unknown to be brought in for union meeting

clue.text: You crudely gut two hens to feed royal horse
